meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 安装 rtk 代理，让 Claude 在容器中执行 Bash 命令（如 git、cargo、pytest、docker、kubectl 等）时自动压缩 token，节省 60–90% 的 token 消耗。
howto.when: 当你在容器中运行 Bash 工具（如 git status、cargo build 等）时，rtk 会自动拦截并压缩 token。

say.note: rtk 会压缩输出，节省 token。
rtk 自动拦截，减少 token 消耗。

say.text: 查看 rtk 节省了多少 token
say.note: 运行 ~/.local/bin/rtk gain 查看统计。

howto.what_en: Installs the rtk proxy into agent containers, routing Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands like git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.
howto.when_en: When you run a Bash tool (e.g., git status, cargo build) inside the container, rtk automatically intercepts and compresses the output to save tokens.

say_en.note: rtk compresses the output, saving tokens.
rtk intercepts and reduces token usage.

say_en.text: Check how many tokens rtk saved
